book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn LUK

content: Peidek duwen Rahnen Sapad
Rahnen Sapad ehu Sises ahpw ketin keid nan mwetin wihd ehu. Sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw dolungada wahn wihd kei oh irihris nan pehrail oh kangkang kohla.
Parisi kei ahpw patohwanohng irail, “Dahme kumwail wiewiahki mehkot me atail Kosonnedo keinapwih en dehr wiawi ni rahnen Sapad?”
Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kumwail sohte kin wadek dahme Depit wiadahro ahnsou me ih oh ienge ko duhpeklao?

Duwen eh pedolong nan tehnpas en Koht, ale lopwon en pilawa sarawi kei, tungoalehla oh kihong ienge ko pwe re en iang tungoale. Ahpw atail Kosonnedo keinapwih aramas en dehr iang tungoale pilawa sarawi ko, pwe samworo kante.”
Sises ahpw pil mahsanih, “Nein-Aramas iei me pil Kaunen Sapad.”
Ohl Pehmwoator men
Pil rahnen Sapad ehu Sises ketilong nan sinakoke ehu pwe en ketin wia ie sapwellime padahk. A ohl emen iang patopato wasao me peh palimwaun mwoator.
Sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo oh Parisi kei kin anahne diar mehkot sapwung rehn Sises pwe re en kedipahki. Irail eri mwasamwasahnte ma Sises soh pahn ketin kakehlahda ohl pehmwoatoro ni rahnen Sapado.
A ni Sises eh ketin mwahngih arail lamalam, e ahpw mahsanihalahng me pehmwoatoro, “Kowe, patodahdo mahs oh uhda met.” Ohlo eri patodahla oh kesihnenda mwohrail.

Sises ahpw mahsanihong sounkawehwe oh Parisi ko, “I men idek rehmwail mehkot: dahme atail Kosonnedo mweidohng kitail en wia rahnen Sapad? Kitail en kin wia me mwahu de me suwed, doarehla mour de kauwehla?”
E mahsanihirailseli ahpw mahsanihong me pehmwoatoro, “Eri, kapahwei pehmwen.” Ohlo kapahlahte peho e pa mwahula.
Sounkawehwe oh Parisi ko eri lingeringerda kowahlap oh tapihada kapwukapwung nanpwungarail dahme re kak wiahiong Sises.
Sises Pilada Wahnpoaron Ehk Riemen
Kedekedeo, Sises ahpw ketidahla pohn dohl ehu pwe en loulou ie. Ih eri ketiket wasao wie loulou, wasa lao rahnpeseng.
Nimensengo e ahpw ketin malipepene sapwellime tohnpadahk ko oh ketin pilada sang rehrail me ehk riemen, me e ketikihong mwararail, wahnpoaron.
Eri, iet irail akan: Saimon (me e pil kahdaneki Piter) oh rie Andru; Seims oh Sohn, Pilip oh Pardolomiu;
Madiu oh Tomas, Seims nein Alpius oh Saimon (tohn pwihnen Selod;)
Sudas nein Seims, oh Sudas Iskariot, ohl me pahn pangala Sises.
Sises Kapahrek oh Kakehlahda me Soumwahu kan

Sises eri ketidi sang pohn dohlo oh wahnpoaron ko patohwan iang; e ahpw ket nan wasa patapat kis iangahki sapwellime tohnpadahk tohto. Aramas ngeder pil iang mi wasao, me pokondo sang wasa koaros en Sudia, sang Serusalem, sang kahnimw en ni oaroahr kan en Dair oh Saidon.
Re patodohng iang rong Sises oh ale kakehlepen ar soumwahu kan. Pil irail ko me ngehn saut tiadahr pohrail, re iang mi wasao oh iang ale kakehleparail.
Aramas koaros ahpw kin men doahke Sises, pwehki roson eh kin pwilipwilsang, oh e kin ketin kakehlahda me soumwahu kan koaros.
Pai oh Nsensuwed
Sises eri ketin mahmahsanih sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, oh mahsanih,

content.text: pwe iei amwail wehi, Wehin Koht!
“Meid pai kumwail me men mwengedahr ahnsou wet,
“Meid pai kumwail me kin sengiseng ahnsou wet,

content: “Meid pai kumwail ni aramas akan ar pahn kailongkin kumwail, kasohwei kumwail, kasaroweikumwaildi, oh kauwehla adamwail kan pwehki Nein-Aramas.
Kumwail perenda oh ngisingiski amwail peren ahnsowo, pwe ketingpamwail nanleng me laud mehlel. Pwe ih duwen me samarail ko wiahiong soukohp ko.

content.text: “A meid suwediong kumwail me kepwehpwe kan ahnsou wet;
pwehki amwail aleier mour nsenamwahu nin sampah!
“Meid suwediong kumwail kan me med ahnsou wet,
“Meid suwediong kumwail kan me kin kouruhr ahnsou wet,
pwe kumwail pahn mwahiei oh sengiseng!

content: “Meid suwediong kumwail, ma aramas koaros pahn kapingai kumwail, pwe ih duwen me samarail ko wiahiong soukohp likamw ako.”
Limpoak ong Atail Imwintihti kan
“Eri, I pahn ndaiong kumwail koaros me rongorong ie: kumwail poakohng amwail imwintihti kan; kumwail wia mwahu ong me kin kailongkin kumwail;
kumwail kupwuramwahwih me kin kerieikumwailla; kumwail kapakapki me kin wia suwed ong kumwail.
Ma mehmen pohr apali likin sepomw, a pil mweidohng apali. A ma emen kihsang omw sekid, mweidohng en pil ale omw seht.
Kihong aramas koaros mehkot me re pahn peki rehmw; oh ma emen pahn kihsang mehkot me uhdahn ahmw, ke dehpa peki en kapwuredohng uhk.
Duwen me ke men aramas en wiahiong uhk, ih duwen me ke pahn wiahiong irail.
“Ma kumwail pahn poakohngete irail kan me poakohng kumwail, soangen pai da me kumwail koapworopworki en ale? Pwe me dipan akan pil kin poakohng irail kan me kin poakohng irail.
Oh ma kumwail pahn wia me mwahu ongete me kin wia mwahu ong kumwail, soangen pai da me kumwail koapworoporki en ale? Pwe me dipan akan pil kin wia soahngohte.

Oh ma kumwail pahn kihong mehkot ong irail kante me kumwail kasikasik kasapahlpe sang rehr, soangen pai da me kumwail kasikasik en ale? Pwe me dipan akan pil kin kihong me dipan akan pwe re en pil ale dupukpe!

Eri soh, kumwail poakohng amwail imwintihti kan oh wia mwahu ong irail; kumwail kihong irail mehkot ahpw dehr kasikasik kasapahlpe sang rehrail. Pwe katingpamwail pahn laud mehlel oh kumwail pahn wiahla sapwellimen Koht, Wasa Lapalahpie. Pwe e kin ketin kalahngan ong me kin dup suwed kan oh me suwed akan.
Kumwail eri kin kalahngan, duwehte Samamwail me ketin kupwurkalahngan.”
Duwen Kadeikada Meteikan

“Kumwail dehr kadeik meteikan pwe kumwail dehr pakadeida rehn Koht; kumwail dehr keriahla meteikan pwe kumwail dehr ale keriapamwail rehn Koht; kumwail mahkohng meteikan pwe Koht en ketin mahkohng kumwail.

Kumwail kihwei, pwe kumwail en ale dupukpe sang rehn Koht; kumwail wia kisakis sapan, e ahpw pahn ketin kasapahldohng kumwail ni uwe ieu me itar, me laudsang, me siksang kowahlap. Pwe mehn sohngohte me kumwail pahn sohngki meteikan, ih me Koht pahn pil ketin sohngkin kumwail.”
Sises ahpw pil mahsanihong irail karasaras pwoatet: “Sohte aramas maskun men kak kaweid emen maskun. Pwe ma e pahn wia met, ira koaros pahn pwupwudiong nan warawar.
Sohte tohnpadahk men kin lapalapasang eh sounpadahk; ahpw tohnpadahk koaros, ni ar pahn deila mehlel, re pahn kin duwehla ar sounpadahk kan.
“Dahme kumwail kin nsenohki pwul en mesen riamwail kan, kumwail ahpw sohte kin tehk ataut me mi nan pein pwoaren masamwail kan?

Ia duwen amwail kak ndahng riamwailo, ‘Nahn! Ke dehr mahs, pwe I en kihsang pwulen nan mesomwen,’ ni amwail sohte pein kehn atauten nan pwoaren masamwail kan? Mwalaun kei kumwail! Kihsang mahs atauten nan pwoaren masamwail kan, kumwail ahpw pahn kak kilang duwen amwail pahn kihsang pwul nan mesen riamwailo.”
Tuhke Pwoat oh Wah kan
“Tuhke mwahu pwoat sohte kin wa suwed; pil tuhke suwed pwoat sohte kin wa mwahu.
Kitail kin esehki tuhke koaros wahrail kan. Sohte me kak dolungasang wahn wain ni tuhke tekatek kan, de dolungasang kehngid ni tuhke leles.

Aramas mwahu men kin kapwarehda mehkan me mwahu pwehki eh mohngiong direki me mwahu; duwehte aramas suwed men kin kapwarehda me suwed pwehki eh mohngiong direki me suwed. Pwe ewen aramas kin kapwadewei dahme audepen nan eh mohngiong.”
Sounkou Ihmw Riemen
“Eri, da katepen amwail ekehkerkin ie, ‘Maing at Kaun, Maing at Kaun,’ nan amwail sohte kin kapwaiada me I kin padahkihong kumwail?
I pahn kasalehiong kumwail duwen mehmen me kin kodohng ie oh rong ei padahk kan oh kin kapwaiada.

E pahn rasehng aramas me kin kauwada imwe: e kin weirada pwehl lel paip, e ahpw kin poahsoanehdi imwe pohn paipo. Oh ni lapake eh kin pwilido oh lel ihmwo, e sohte kak kamwakidada, pwehki eh kokoudahr pohn paip.

A me kin rong ei padahk kan oh sohte kapwaiada, e kin rasehng aramas me kin kauwada imwe pohn pwehl ahpw sohte poahsoane. Eri, ahnsou me lapake kin pwilido oh lel ihmwo, e kin pwupwudi oh rengkpeseng. Ia pahn uwen ohla wet!”
